Record Class ImplicitCallTarget.Direct

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
sootup.callgraph.implicit.ImplicitCallTarget.Direct
Record Components:
position - the value on which the method is called
subSignature - the subsignature of the called method
declaringClass - the class in which the called method is looked up, or null to use the static type of the value
parameterMapping - maps argument indices of the implicit call's source call to parameter indices of the called method; unmapped parameters receive no value
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImplicitCallTarget
Enclosing interface:
ImplicitCallTarget
public static record ImplicitCallTarget.Direct(int position, @NonNull MethodSubSignature subSignature, @Nullable ClassType declaringClass, @NonNull Map<Integer,Integer> parameterMapping) extends Record implements ImplicitCallTarget
Calls the method with the given subsignature on the value at the given position, e.g. run() on the Runnable that is passed to Executor.execute(Runnable).

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
